item: row 361 group 7: the advanced-search notes, filter caveats, analysis loading lines and competitive panel follow a language switch
summary: Explore -> advanced search: the save, copy-link, NEAR-default and search-history notes and the four per-filter caveats (words, sentiment, mentions, quarantine) wrote t()/tf() output into ordinary nodes and froze in the language they were drawn in; the analysis keyword, article and mind-map loading lines and the competitive panel's empty line did the same. They now draw through ooLive/ooLiveHtml (row 364); an error's own words stay data inside the translated frame. No new strings. Seven lines leave configs/i18n_frozen_renderers.txt.
